output.answer: Alphabet’s latest reported results are for Q3 2026, ended September 30, 2026 and released October 28, 2026. Revenue was $127.577 billion, up 25% year over year; operating income was $40.576 billion, net income available to common stockholders was $26.170 billion, and diluted EPS was $2.12. Google Cloud revenue rose 103% year over year to $30.709 billion, while Google Services revenue increased 11% to $96.302 billion.
caveats: These are unaudited Q3 2026 results; Q3 2026 is the latest quarter reported as of 2026-11-11.
